text:
Anya: Heads-up — we need a fresh battlecard iteration for next Wed webinar. Primary opponents: large cloud AI platforms + a couple LLM API infra vendors. Goal: tight launch post, benchmark narratives that survive QA, webinar punchlines, and clear inbound routing for SDRs/AEs. Who can own claims + one-pager?
Matt: I can take claims + short rebut lines. Need the latest benchmark numbers (latency/cost) to cite. @Sofia, can you surface the bench deck excerpt?
Sofia: Uploading excerpt in a sec. Draft topline: 'Redwood: up to 3x lower 95th-pct latency vs typical multi-tenant cloud deployments at 8k tokens; ~20–30% lower per-token cost when using prefix caching and aggressive batching.' These are draft—need to add test conditions.
Jordan: Tone suggestion: replace absolute phrasing with context. e.g., 'up to 3x' + parentheses with test rig: model family, batch=8, seq=8k, baseline cloud SKU. Also add margin-of-error note.
Devon: Also add reliability line: 'Automatic fallback routing to compatible model variants and regional failover preserves availability under load' — customers care about graceful degradation more than raw peak throughput.
Matt: For the launch post: headline + 3 bullets (latency, cost, predictable capacity). I'll draft a short post. Also need inbound routing snippet for SDRs: qualification questions and routing tags.
Anya: Proposed routing rule (draft): if ARR >= $250k OR monthly_tokens > 500000 then route to AE; else SDR. Tag candidates with "DedicatedEligible" and "HighLatencyPain".
Sofia: Sharing sample SDR script and a tiny dashboard screenshot. SDR script: 'Hi — quick question: do you have latency SLOs (99th) under 500ms? Are GPU costs limiting model scale? If yes, mark HighLatencyPain.'
Sam (analytics-bot): Quick stat: last quarter 12 enterprise trials flagged latency as primary blocker; top verticals: fintech, health, ad-tech.
Jordan: Battlecard rebut template: 1) Claim, 2) Why they say it, 3) Our counter (evidence + 90s demo), 4) Suggested demo prompt. Example: Claim: 'Cloud vendor has unified infra' -> Counter: 'Our routing + SLA + cost snapshot shows predictable performance without DIY ops' + demo: run same prompt to two endpoints and surface 95th latency and per-token cost.
Devon: Add an AE elevator: 'Control inference cost and uptime without building infra' and a 30s webinar punchline: 'Keep dependably fast, affordable inference — across hosted, reserved, and private deployments.'
Anya: Action items: Matt = claims + launch post draft; Sofia = benchmark doc snippet + SDR script; Jordan = rebut templates + demo howto; Devon = AE elevator + webinar one-liner. Can everyone have PRs by EOD Friday? We’ll sync Monday to fold into deck.
Matt: On it, will open PR and ping here with link.
Sofia: Uploading branch /marketing/battlecards/1955-battlecard-rework now. :rocket: 
Jordan: I'll add a concise demo checklist for hosts (90s steps, expected metrics to display).
Devon: Also suggest we include a tiny FAQ for procurement: licensing, dedicated capacity SLAs, private deployment options.
Anya: Perfect. If we can lock language and supporting bench snippets by Friday we can push a preview to sales for early feedback. Thanks all.
